assertions.name: alpha_em_habiro_is_exactly_bar_even
assertions.source: H = [2]_q·(1−h²α) satisfies H(1/q) = H(q) exactly — it is purely bar-even (charge-conjugation-symmetric), the sector PR #1602 requires of the Q_β scaling map f.

assertions.name: alpha_em_habiro_zero_at_zeta4
assertions.source: H(ζ_4) = H(q=i) = 0 exactly — α_EM's modular node, the dual of Q_β's ζ_4 pole (PR #1622).

description: Apply the Q_β q-difference / root-of-unity / Fourier machinery (PRs #1593/#1602/#1622) to the α_EM Habiro element H = [2]_q·(1−h²α) = (q+q⁻¹)(1−(q−q⁻¹)²α). Computes the exact root-of-unity spectrum H(ζ_d) (the Fourier modes of σ_q), the special values H(ζ_1)=2 (classical α/4π), H(ζ_2)=−2 (bar mode), H(ζ_4)=0 (a ZERO — vs Q_β's pole), confirms H is exactly bar-even (purely the charge-conjugation-symmetric sector PR #1602 requires), and reproduces the established h-Taylor recursion + q₀ truncation. Exact symbolic; sharpens the α_EM modular target, no closure of the open derived form.

habiro_element.h_basis: h = q − q⁻¹ (Hecke differential; distinct from Habiro u=q^{1/2} and ladder u_ladder=b·ℏ²)

root_of_unity_spectrum.H_symbolic: alpha*cos(2*pi/7) + alpha*sin(3*pi/14) + alpha*cos(pi/7) + alpha*sin(5*pi/14) - I*alpha*cos(3*pi/14)/(4*sin(pi/14)) + I*alpha*cos(3*pi/14)/2 + I*alpha*cos(pi/14)/2 + 3*cos(2*pi/7)/4 + 5*sin(3*pi/14)/4

special_values.contrast_with_qbeta: α_EM has a ZERO at ζ_4; Q_β had a POLE at ζ_4 (PR #1622) — dual modular nodes

interpretation.open: α_EM next-order derived form (alpha-em ledger) — modular target sharpened (H(ζ_4)=0 node), not closed
